resources.string: Reads only Rav-Pass\'s ticket screens (the one that says your ride is paid, and the ticket for inspection when you open it), whenever one is open: the line, the stations, the time, the ticket number, the passengers and the ticket\'s code, so Kav can show your ticket. To read the code it takes a picture of the screen while a ticket screen is open, and lets it go at once. It stays on this phone and is deleted when the ticket ends or when you turn off Pay with Rav-Pass in Kav. Right after a purchase it opens your ticket in Rav-Pass to read its code, and touches nothing else. On Rav-Pass\'s other screens it reads only the few lines Kav\'s own explanation names, and nothing in any other app. It can tell which app is in front, and reads only Rav-Pass\'s screen.
Shows a widget of one of your Kav extensions
